## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 jul 2026 - 5 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _liz h_, 5 sept 2026, 1/5: "over 2 months later still not fixed. unable to enter sleep every day. Why is this not sorted by now? Intriguing reading all the broken app comments & that Samsung have chosen to respond only to a select few. the overriding customer feedback is that the latest update in July has broken the app, but feedback from Samsung does not provide any indication of a fix. Samsung, put your hands up, admit the mistake and get it fixed."
            2. _Darryl Brooks_, 5 sept 2026, 1/5: "I came here to lower my score to a 1 after the latest update which rendered the app useless. It doesn't stay active during my workout so I can monitor my run/walk. It no longer gives me mile splits, and it crashes frequently. Looking for a replacement if anyone has any suggestions."
            3. _JWM B_, 24 jul 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
